I can’t access or modify files from here. To back up and overwrite config.json yourself, run one of these sets of commands.

Unix / macOS (bash):
- Backup: cp config.json config.json.bak
- Overwrite: printf '%s' '{"mode":"strict","retries":2}' > config.json

Windows PowerShell:
- Backup: Copy-Item -Path config.json -Destination config.json.bak
- Overwrite: Set-Content -Path config.json -Value '{"mode":"strict","retries":2}' -NoNewline

If config.json is tracked by git and you want a git-stored backup instead, create a copy and commit it before overwriting.
